dialogues.speaker: Nigina
dialogues.text: They all went to the Akademiya and became official researchers, too busy to come home more than a couple times a year.

dialogues.speaker: Nigina
dialogues.text: So that leaves my old bones here.

dialogues.speaker: Nigina
dialogues.text: They have a great future ahead of them, so no complaints from me. I just want to know how they're doing.
